name: windows-hardware-issues
title: Hardware Issues
description: Problem devices, disk health, battery, memory and hardware error events

checks.title: Plug and Play devices with a non-OK status
command: $bad = @(Get-PnpDevice -PresentOnly -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Status -ne 'OK' } | Select-Object FriendlyName, Class, Status, InstanceId)

checks.title: Physical disk health, reliability counters and SMART failure prediction
Battery health (laptops)
command: try { $full = (Get-CimInstance -Namespace root/wmi -ClassName BatteryFullChargedCapacity -ErrorAction Stop | Select-Object -First 1).FullChargedCapacity } catch {}
try { $design = (Get-CimInstance -Namespace root/wmi -ClassName BatteryStaticData -ErrorAction Stop | Select-Object -First 1).DesignedCapacity } catch {}
try { $cycles = (Get-CimInstance -Namespace root/wmi -ClassName BatteryCycleCount -ErrorAction Stop | Select-Object -First 1).CycleCount } catch {}

ConvertTo-Json -InputObject ([pscustomobject]@{ present = $true; name = $b.Name; statusCode = $b.BatteryStatus; chargePct = $b.EstimatedChargeRemaining; designCapacity_mWh = $design; fullChargeCapacity_mWh = $full; healthPct = $health; cycleCount = $cycles }) -Compress

checks.title: Installed memory modules
command: Get-CimInstance Win32_PhysicalMemory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object BankLabel, DeviceLocator, @{ n = 'GB'; e = { [math]::Round($_.Capacity / 1GB) } }, Speed, Manufacturer, PartNumber | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 200

checks.title: Critical and error events in the System log (last 7 days)
command: 'No critical/error events in the System log in the last 7 days.'

$events | Select-Object @{ n = 'Time'; e = { $_.TimeCreated.ToString('s') } }, Id, ProviderName, @{ n = 'Message'; e = { if ($_.Message) { ($_.Message -split '\r?\n')[0] } } } | Format-Table -AutoSize -Wrap | Out-String -Width 220
